licence.scope: Isaac Newton Group (ING) site-wide Legal Notice, level 3 (footer link): it covers the contents of the ING website and does not name the filter curves. The ING filter database cited by SVO (http://catserver.ing.iac.es/filter/, list.php?instrument=WFC) did not answer with curl on 2026-10-26 (no HTTP response), so no page-level statement could be checked. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.

notes: DetectorType of Strom_u, Strom_v, Strom_b, Strom_y set to photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-11-11), the label every served copy of the same curve now carries: ING's filter database gives this curve as 'ING Filter Throughput Data' of the filter alone, in percent, scanned on 2005-03-02 (catserver.ing.iac.es/filter/filtercurve.php, archived 2010; https://astro.ing.iac.es/filter/), for the INT Wide Field Camera, which 'consists of 4 thinned EEV42 2kx4k CCDs' (https://www.ing.iac.es/astronomy/instruments/wfc/). A filter-only transmission used with a CCD counts photons. SVO's DetectorType is not used.
